description: This file provides helper functions for configuring and calculating DMRS (Demodulation Reference Signal) information in 5G NR scheduling, including factory functions for different configurations and calculations related to DMRS symbols, ports, and groups.

methods.name: calculate_nof_dmrs_per_rb
methods.description: Calculates the number of RE (Resource Elements) used for DMRS per RB based on configuration.

methods.name: make_dmrs_info_common
methods.description: Factory function to create default DM-RS information for DCI f1_0 or when higher layer config is unavailable, for various resource configurations.

methods.name: make_dmrs_info_dedicated
methods.description: Factory function to create dedicated DM-RS information with specific configurations, including antenna port mapping.
